source_excerpt: Amoxicillin capsules are contraindicated in patients who have experienced a serious hypersensitivity reaction
Ibuprofen tablets are contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to ibuprofen.
Ciprofloxacin is contraindicated in persons with a history of hypersensitivity to ciprofloxacin
Fluconazole tablets are contraindicated in patients who have shown hypersensitivity to fluconazole
Azithromycin tablets are contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to azithromycin.
Levothyroxine sodium tablets are contraindicated in patients with uncorrected adrenal insufficiency
Azithromycin tablets are contraindicated in patients with a history of cholestatic jaundice/hepatic dysfunction associated with prior use of azithromycin.
Ibuprofen tablets are contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
Fluoroquinolones, including Ciprofloxacin, may exacerbate muscle weakness in patients with myasthenia gravis.
A high percentage of patients with mononucleosis who receive amoxicillin develop an erythematous skin rash.
